risks.title: Product liability claims in pharmaceuticals
risks.score_rationale: Major risk positioned first in Item 1A, highly intensive language ('significant risk', 'substantial damages', 'material adverse effect'), stable trend with current litigation (Taxotere, Zantac, Talc, Depakine), high weight for pharma sector.

risks.title: Ethics compliance, anti-corruption, and commercial practices
risks.score_rationale: Critical risk positioned second, highly intensive language ('heavily regulated', 'strengthening enforcement'), ongoing litigation (pricing, 340B program), categorical weight with reputational and market exclusion implications.

risks.title: Regulatory approvals and GMP compliance, FDA-EMA inspections
risks.score_rationale: Critical risk positioned third, highly intensive language ('extensive legislation', 'costly compliance'), concrete recent event (FDA warning letter January 2025 for Framingham), direct impact on supply continuity and time-to-market.

risks.title: EU regulatory fragmentation and US political changes
risks.score_rationale: Major risk with intensive language ('significant operational challenges', 'material adverse effect'), new/rising trend (2024 US electoral changes, EU MDR/IVDR revision underway), impact on approval timelines and market access.

risks.title: Intellectual property and patent dependence
risks.score_rationale: Major risk explicitly referenced in Item 1A ('We rely on our patents'), moderate but clear language on financial impact, stable trend, high categorical weight for pharma sector with patent exclusivity cycles.

risks.title: Supply chain risks and production continuity
risks.score_rationale: Major risk implicit in GMP/inspection discussions and compliance failures, intensive language ('supply continuity consequences'), stable trend but heightened by recent events (FDA warning letter), direct operational impact.

risks.title: Post-market safety profile evolution of products
risks.score_rationale: Major sector-specific pharma risk, intensive language ('rare, population-specific, long-term adverse events'), stable trend but inherent to product lifecycle, impact on labeling and market withdrawals.

risks.title: Historical contamination and environmental obligations
risks.score_rationale: Major risk explicitly referenced ('Management of historical contamination'), moderate but clear language on reputational and operational impact, stable trend, medium categorical weight for pharma industrial sector.
